AN ACT SEPARATING THE LEONARDO NATIONAL HIGH
SCHOOL — DAWA ANNEX IN BARANGAY DAWA,
MUNICIPALITY OF JOSEFINA, PROVINCE OF
ZAMBOANGA DEL SUR FROM THE LEONARDO
NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL, CONVERTING ITINTO AN
INDEPENDENT NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL TO BE
KNOWN AS DAWA NATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL AND
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the
Philippines in Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. Separation and Conversion into a National
High School. — The Leonardo National High School —- Dawa
Annex in Barangay Dawa, Municipality of Josefina, Province of
Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the Leonardo
National High School and converted into an independent national
high school to be known as Dawa National High School.

SEC. 2. Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. ~ All personnel,
assets, liabilities and records of the Leonardo National High School
~ Dawa Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Dawa
National High School.
 
SEC. 3. Appropriations. — The Secretary of Education
shall immediately include in the Department's program the
operationalization of the Dawa National High School, the initial
funding of which shall be charged against the current year's
appropriations of the Leonardo National High School — Dawa
Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued
operation of the school shall be included in the annual General
Appropriations Act.

SEC. 4. Implementation. — The Secretary of Education
shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to
carry out the purpose of this Act.

SEC. 5. Effectivity/— This Act shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publicgtion in the Official Gazette.
